verdict.rationale: The pack documents an Invoicing API with reference endpoints, official libraries, an MCP server, a CLI and an llms.txt docs index, but none of these is a downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec. The probe found 404s at every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path. llms.txt and markdown docs are documentation for LLMs, not a machine-readable API spec, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
